references.text: The rest of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons - a most holy part of the Lord's fire offering
Aaron and his sons shall eat what remains of the grain offering, and it shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place
All male priests may eat from the guilt offering; it shall be eaten in a holy place, for it is most holy
The priest may eat from his God's food, both the most holy and the holy things
The most holy offerings belong to the priests, and all males among them shall eat it in a holy place
Whatever touches the altar shall become holy - parallel to the principle that whatever touches the holy becomes holy
What touches these holy things shall become holy
